description: Image Description: The image displays a close-up view of two sandwiches, likely submarine-style or hoagie rolls, placed side by side on a white paper wrapper. Each sandwich is made with a poppy seed bun, which is golden brown and speckled with small black poppy seeds. Inside the buns, there are large, whole dill pickles that dominate the filling, along with thick slices of red tomato. There are also visible pieces of chopped white onions and fresh green herbs,
